chunks: The Christians narrate that among those who preceded them, there was one who lived seven hundred years and more.
ai.seo_question: What do Christians say about the lifespan of their ancestors according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Al-Tusi cites this Christian tradition to establish a baseline for extraordinary longevity in pre-Islamic eras, thereby contextualizing the miraculous long lives of the Imams within a broader historical framework of divine favor. This comparison underscores that extended lifespans are not unprecedented but are elevated in the Ahl al-Bayt to signify their unique spiritual status and role as guides during periods of occultation.
